design: Existing d16/l2 factored spatial ViT, plus 16 coupling-input bias weights; all weights train. Same saved J=.5 physical-input parents for both representations. Exact finite-support A1 for both, polynomial S2 singlet projection only for VAP. Same parameters, not same projected physical initial states. Shared 300x3 versus five independently optimized pointwise 180x1 gives 900 total-H objectives per representation/seed. Wall time and projection costs are not matched; measured separately. Pointwise baselines train at held-out J by definition, shared fits never do. Final step only, no model/epoch/seed selection. This is exact-small symmetry ablation, not a scalable decoder or full foundation model.
response_gate: First report exact internal derivative/FD agreement and Hellmann-Feynman defect. Without independently accurate held-out ground states or susceptibilities, do not claim response accuracy or phase boundaries. Only J=.5 has a cached exact energy anchor; no synthetic reference at other J.
continuation_policy: Checkpoints retained; no automatic extension, N36 training or GPU release. Shared transfer judged on both fixed parents; two correlated historical warmstarts do not provide an uncertainty estimate. Parent training costs inherited and separately documented.
